scope: Political Landscape Step 1 - starting realm roster and province ownership
rules: Ownership data in starting_realm_ownership_v1.json is the source of truth.
The PNG is a visualization only and must never become the ownership authority.
Future ownership edits must be made in canonical data first, then visualizations regenerated deterministically.
Do not reconstruct ownership by reading colors from raster images.
Do not use image generation for authoritative political-map overlays.
Realm identity, names, capitals, culture, faith, governments, rulers, history and campaign-start diplomacy are outside this freeze.

rejected_superseded_visuals.reason: Not authoritative; reconstruction method incorrectly produced 46 realm groups and quality degraded.

rejected_superseded_visuals.description: Any image-generated political-map rendition produced during this phase
rejected_superseded_visuals.reason: Image generation altered authoritative geography and cannot be used for deterministic cartographic output.
